title: Valhallowed secrets
description: Sensitive values for one install, written in TOML apart from the manifest (G18). The key set is closed: an unknown key is rejected. Ingress enforces what this schema cannot express: every world named here is also in the manifest.

password.description: At least five characters. The game asks that only of a listed server, which also refuses a password that is part of the world's name or seed; VHD asks the length of every world, so listing one later needs no new password if it avoids those.

schema.description: The schema version this file is written against, the same as the manifest's.

world.description: Each world's secrets, keyed by its save name as in the manifest.

password.description: The password players type to join the world. Unset, the world has no password.
